Description: Real B2B enquiries only. NovaPharm AWS eu-north-1 contact reception, durable 30-day DynamoDB receipts, verified internal SNS email notices. No clinical uploads or portal authentication. Lambda concurrency uses account unreserved quota; HTTP API and DDB rate limiting enforce intake bounds.

RateSalt.Description: Per-deployment server-side rate-limit hash salt; never put in GitHub/client

ApprovedNotificationTopicArn.Description: Existing confirmed internal email alert topic; only receipt metadata, no PII

Assertions.AssertDescription: NovaPharm contact must only deploy in eu-north-1

Properties.AlarmDescription: NovaPharm production contact intake Lambda error; inspect private logs, never send enquiry PII via SNS

ContactApiOrigin.Description: Direct HTTPS API Gateway origin; deploy public form only after end-to-end validation
